'''Georgia's Beartic''' (Japanese: '''ラングレーのツンベアー''' ''Langley's Tunbear'') is the first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} seen under [[Georgia]]'s ownership. It is also her main Pokémon.

==History==
[[File:Georgia and Beartic.png|thumb|250px|left|Beartic and Georgia]]
Beartic debuted in ''[[BW033|Iris and Excadrill Against the Dragon Buster!]]'', where it was sent out by its {{pkmn|Trainer}} to battle {{cat|Iris's Pokémon}}. During the battle, it took out both {{TP|Iris|Axew}} and {{TP|Iris|Excadrill}}, resulting in victory for Georgia. It was sent out again the next day to battle Excadrill. Even though Excadrill was no longer disobedient towards his Trainer, the battle ended in a draw.

In ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'', it was used to battle {{OBP|Sylvester|BW039}}'s {{p|Joltik}} in the first round of the [[Club Battle]]. After taking heavy damage from {{m|Thunderbolt}}, it collapsed on the Attaching Pokémon, crushing it with its weight and winning the match.

In ''[[BW081|Crisis at Ferroseed Research!]]'', Beartic helped clear the moss covering the [[Ferroseed Research Institute]] created by the {{p|Ferroseed}} there.

In ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup]]'', Beartic was used to battle {{an|Iris}}'s {{TP|Iris|Dragonite}} in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]]. Despite having a major [[type]] advantage and Dragonite disobeying Iris, Beartic was [[Fainting|knocked out]] by one {{m|Thunder Punch}}, eliminating Georgia from the tournament.

==Personality and characteristics==
True to its species, Beartic appears to be very powerful. It also is the kind of Pokémon that proudly follows the title of its Trainer, in this case Georgia being a prominent {{type|Ice}} user. Beartic is very loyal to its Trainer and takes great pride in battling any Pokémon, even one against which it is at a disadvantage. Beartic also seems to be quite persistent, such as when it kept on eliminating the rapidly growing moss coming from the {{p|Ferroseed}} despite being tired from using multiple {{m|Ice Beam}}s.
